title: I built an online ARPG auto-battler with AI as a Thai solo dev. It works in Thailand, but how do I reach players outside?
author: gunnrcrakr
selftext:
Hi everyone 👋 I'm a solo dev from Thailand, and English isn't my first language, so please bear with me 😅

For the past few months I've been building **Lumen Saga** with heavy help from AI. AI agents write and test a big part of the code, and AI helps with art and marketing too. My own job is mostly design, balance and deciding what feels fun. Honestly, I couldn't have built something this big alone without it.

The game is an online ARPG auto-battler that runs in the browser on mobile and PC, with no download. You build a team, mix skill gems with support gems (over a million combos), set "when X, do Y" tactics, and let the heroes fight. There are no quests, no getting lost, offline auto, and no pay to win.

Here's my problem. Almost all of my players are Thai. My page, my community and word of mouth all stay inside Thailand. The game already supports English, but international players just don't find it.

So I'd love to hear from people here:

1. Where did your first international players come from? Reddit, Discord, [itch.io](http://itch.io), TikTok, YouTubers?
2. Does saying a game is AI-assisted help or hurt when you promote it to players, not devs?
3. Are paid ads worth it for a small browser game? Which countries would you test first?
4. Has anyone used AI to localize store pages, trailers or social posts for other markets? What worked?

Any experience, even "don't do what I did", would help a lot. I'm also happy to share my AI workflow if anyone's curious.

Thanks for reading! 🙏
